title: 论文内声明验证：辅助同行评审的新框架
summary: 提出一种利用LLM验证论文中新颖性声明与方法证据一致性的框架，通过提取声明、检索证据并基于评审标准评估，显著提升与人类评审意见的匹配度。
summary_en: Introduces an intra-paper claim verification framework using LLMs to check if novelty claims are supported by methodological evidence, showing strong alignment with human reviewer concerns.
